# examples/popover throws on load and renders nothing

**Claim it first:** comment on this issue before you start, and check the open pull requests for one that already points here. We merge the first approve-worthy PR (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`, point 3). This row comes from #19920, where @bercedev has first pick on its rows.

## Context

Welcome! This is one row of #19920, split out so that its fix closes its own ticket. You need a fork, Node and the dev server (`npm run server-start`); no Agent OS, Docker or AI tooling.

A headless sweep of every example page on 2026-10-20 found `examples/popover` throwing during construction and rendering nothing. It still does on `dev` `f5decee2c0`. Open `http://localhost:8080/examples/popover/index.html` and the console shows `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'removeDom')`. The page fails the same way at `13.2.0`, so this predates 13.3.

## The Problem

The error comes from `src/container/Base.mjs:248` (`items[i].vdom.removeDom`) inside `afterSetIsVnodeInitializing` (`:241`).

## The Architectural Reality

- `afterSetIsVnodeInitializing` walks the container's `items` and reads each item's `vdom`.
- An entry that is not yet a component instance (still a config object) has no `vdom`.

## The Fix

The likely cause, which the fix confirms or corrects: the hook runs while one of the popover example's `items` is still a config. Skip entries that are not instances, or make sure the items are created before the hook reads them. Fix it in the engine.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `examples/popover` loads with no page error and renders its popovers' triggers.
- [ ] AC-2: a unit test in `test/playwright/unit/` fails before the fix and passes after it.

## Out of Scope

- The other rows of #19920, which have their own tickets.
